critical_findings.finding: Current SW skipWaiting/claim/cache cleanup does not terminate already-running or frozen old document code. No protocol attestation can enumerate/prove all noncooperating writers. Lock availability, zero replies, client count, timeout, recent timestamp and user checkbox do not prove isolation.
Existing timeout/finally opens application even when durable state unreadable. Vault resurrects absent keys before pending recovery and tombstones can be inspected.
Bulk memory changes immediately, persistence/fallback failures swallowed; flush resolves. Logical getItem is not a physical durable read.
If COMMITTED put may have completed but readback fails, do not rollback. Persist/log unknown, keep write blockade, recheck on restart. After proven commit cache/broadcast errors cannot undo data.

Vault initial/mutation writes not drained, onabort may hang Promise. Captured Storage.prototype method composition can schedule mirrors during restore unless raw durable adapters bypass/coordinate patches.
Channel consumer only mem.set on string; absence never mem.delete. No persisted revisions means slow reads and reordered messages can overwrite newer cache. Broadcast loss has no activation refresh.

withBulk overwrites local pinned entries with stale mem values when both exist. Vault export merges stale mirror keys absent from localStorage, potentially resurrecting deletions. Also misses four independent DB families and lacks consistency snapshot across reads.

Vault parser skips >5M chars; trial restore skips >2M though inspection rejects; importVault coercion bypasses checks. Future schema not rejected. Export has no restoreability bound.
Current preview stores no immutable target revision hashes/athlete/generation. Profile defaults after plan restore are a separate write; undo can erase later independent modifications.

recommended_minimal_contract.preflight: Strict parse/version/type/key/credential/athlete/dedup/manifest/hash/UTF-8-length/chunk-order checks; immutable plan includes current athlete/generation and every target physical before hash. Fail any unlisted unsupported item before target writes; explicit limited backup may list exclusions.
recommended_minimal_contract.isolation: Acquire a global cooperative write lock before draining. Default production canProveAllWritersControlled=false for legacy origin. Never treat acknowledgements, timers, SW updates, navigator.locks.query or clients.matchAll as proof. Reject in-place overwrite when proof absent.
recommended_minimal_contract.writer_adaptation: Make normal mutation boundaries async and acquire shared global writer lock around validation + all underlying write transactions; restore holds exclusive lock. Maintain consistent global-then-family lock order. Guard currentStore wrappers, raw localStorage compatibility paths, vault monkey-patch, bulk queue/fallback/migration, core mirror, direct IDB families. Each async continuation checks persisted generation and pending recovery state immediately before writes.
recommended_minimal_contract.prepare: New restore-journal database with operation, physical entries and chunk stores; save complete before and target bytes including absence and every mirror/marker; await tx.complete, reread in fresh transaction, verify manifests/hashes. Write paired generation/initialization sentinels before future operation attempts. Any uncertainty before target writes returns NOT_STARTED or RECOVERY_REQUIRED based on provable phase.
recommended_minimal_contract.apply: Durably mark PREPARED then APPLYING; for every backend/key persist intent first, await physical set/delete or IDB tx.complete, reread native backend, hash-check, then persist receipt. During restore prohibit fallback backend changes and ordinary mirror side effects unless listed in manifest.
recommended_minimal_contract.commit: After all physical target values and receipts verify, persist COMMITTED and positively read it back. A failed readback after write leaves outcome unknown/restricted. COMMITTED is irreversible; cache rebuild/broadcast failure requests cache repair only.
recommended_minimal_contract.rollback: Only after confirming no COMMITTED. Durably ROLLING_BACK; reverse every intent position, including entries missing receipts. Compare current to target/before independently per mirror; third value becomes conflict without overwrite. Verify every rollback and durable receipt; only then ROLLED_BACK. Failed log/read/write keeps RECOVERY_REQUIRED or last nonterminal phase.
recommended_minimal_contract.startup: Before BulkGate activation, vault init, bootCore/defaults and background effects, read both sentinel state and journal. Missing/contradictory marker with existing legacy data is not automatically new install. PREPARED with proven no intent may terminate; APPLYING/ROLLING_BACK roll back; unknown intent/commit/log damage remains restricted. COMMITTED verifies target + receipts before loading caches. Gate never falls through on timeout/error.
recommended_minimal_contract.bulk_consistency: Store each bulk value plus monotonic revision and tombstone together in kv/meta same IDB transaction. Publish key/revision/op after complete; receiver reads persistent row/tombstone, rejects older revision, deletes absent cache. Re-sync on visibility/pageshow and restart. Any family still using localStorage without atomic revision remains explicitly outside global consistency guarantee.
recommended_minimal_contract.safe_old_tab_fallback: Candidate-only import into a fresh generation/operation namespace/database, storing file data without switching active pointer or modifying originals. Persist/verify staged copy. Label as pending verification, not restored or consistent current snapshot; final switch needs enforceable writer isolation plus fresh source diff. If not implementing candidate UI, return NOT_STARTED with retained input and clear reason.
recommended_minimal_contract.backup: Chunked manifest with explicit included/excluded backend families, byte lengths, hashes and chunk order. Export from verified durable reads under supported isolation; do not merge stale mirror/mem over authoritative local pinned data. For unrepresentable blobs/families, refuse complete label or list exclusions. File-save proof requires user reselect/verification, not download/share action.
